name: bb-better-latex
description: Better inline and display LaTeX for BB chat. Renders $...$ that stock BB leaves literal, without turning $5 or $HOME into math.

bb.name: Better LaTeX
bb.description: Renders inline $...$ math in chat. BB only ships $$...$$; this plugin adds single-dollar, \(...\), and \[...\] with currency-safe heuristics, including formulas split across markdown nodes.
